boundsFrame: actual GLB vertex bounds in canonical Y-up coordinates
supportFrame: supportSurfaces: polygon [X,Z], elevation y, clearance above surface; legacy surfaces remain kit-plan metadata
looseSupportMeasurement: Mattress/seat patches are measured against visible upward GLB triangles, not fixture AABB tops. Crowned fabric uses its measured upper contact envelope; measurement.maxContactGap records the maximum sampled gap (limit 0.012 m). Pillows, arm/back frames and holes between bench slats are excluded.

originalVariants.selection: equal requiredVariants, type/style, exact fixtureDims; sourceSpecific aperture entries also require matching original sourceFixtureId

functionalOriginals.selection: Explicit kit=wall_shower, original type/style and nominal dimensions; these functional catalogues are distinct from source-identity exact variants.

originalSteamPump.parametersBasis: existing shared ash_pump requirement, not measured historical equipment

sourceEquipmentOriginals.supportPolicy: No invented patches; cowl remains support/occupancy-unresolved; source-specific only.
